newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks at new unofficial closing record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks at new unofficial closing record.

text.p: Mexican blue chips notched up modest gains to end at an unofficial record for the fourth session in a row on Monday.
Dealers and analysts said shares recovered from early profit-taking as buyers stepped back into the market, encouraged by sound fundamentals.
Preliminary closing figures placed the leading IPC share index .MXX up 12.80 points, or 0.30 percent, at 4,257.43.
